versions.subject: Detect Ghost-In-The-Logs (disabling/bypassing ETW)
versions.detection:
selection_1:
    EventID: 11
    TargetFilename: '*\AppData\Local\Temp\*\PROCEXP152.sys'
selection_2:
    Image|contains:
        - '*\procexp64.exe'
        - '*\procexp.exe'
        - '*\procmon64.exe'
        - '*\procmon.exe'
condition: selection_1 and not selection_2
